correctness.rationale: The proof parametrizes every ordered ellipse quadrilateral, converts side directions to a strictly increasing angle function with derivative \(ab/(a^2\sin^2m+b^2\cos^2m)\), and shows each opposite-angle sum integrates this derivative over total parameter length \(\pi\). A threshold-set exchange argument gives the sharp minimum \(4\arctan(b/a)\). The published angular Ptolemy inequality then gives the exact global upper bound, and the axis-endpoint quadruple attains it. Branch behavior and the circle case are explicitly covered. Finite numerical checks are diagnostic only.
